title: Rabbi Shimon bar Bisna
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He speaks in Rabbi Shimon ben Lakish’s name in [Shabbat 75b](https://www.sefaria.org/Shabbat.75b.3) according to the Bach’s reading; Hyman gives the ordinary reading as Rabbi Shimon ben Kisna. At the end of Eruvin chapter 1, the Rif has Rabbi Shimon bar Bisna speaking in Rabbi Acha’s name. The source is [Jerusalem Talmud Eruvin, at the end of 3:4](https://www.sefaria.org/Jerusalem_Talmud_Eruvin.3.4.5), where the name is Rabbi Shimon bar Karsna.[^1]

notes.text: The linked Shabbat has Shimon ben Kisma report in Resh Lakish’s name. The Yerushalmi has Shimon bar Karsna in Rabbi Acha’s name. Hyman gives Kisna and reports Bisna from the Bach and Rif. [Heilprin’s Bisna headword](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=3467&lang=en) discusses a possible error and the Kisma spelling.
